title: encounter.started payload
description: The region GM opened an encounter (api-contracts.md 2.3.7, contracts.md C-05 v1.1). round{} carries the round parameters of the encounter-* blueprint; without it the gateway falls back to MV_GATEWAY_ROUND_TIMEOUT and MV_GATEWAY_ROUND_IDLE_AFTER_MISSED.

round.description: Optional (C-05 v1.1): the round timer of a group encounter, read from the blueprint.

timeout.description: Go duration of the round, e.g. 60s.
